# Ace Education: full reference

Exam prep and study app. 19 countries, 33 exams, 45,642 practice questions, 8,943 topic notes. Site: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/

## Nigeria
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-nigeria
Exams: WASSCE and NECO SSCE for school leavers, and JAMB UTME for university admission.
Grading: WASSCE/NECO: A1 to F9 (credit = C6 or better). UTME: 0 to 400.
Levels: SS1 – SS3
Totals: 63 subjects, 1,112 topics, 5,753 questions.
- WASSCE (WAEC): Mathematics, English Language, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Government, Commerce, Financial Accounting, Civic Education, Literature in English, Geography, Information and Communication Technology, History, Christian Religious Studies, Islamic Studies, Food and Nutrition, Technical Drawing, Visual Art, French, Further Mathematics, Agricultural Science
- UTME (JAMB): Mathematics, English Language, Physics, Biology, Chemistry, Economics, Government, Commerce, Financial Accounting, Civic Education, Literature in English, Geography, Agricultural Science, History, Christian Religious Studies, Islamic Studies, Food and Nutrition, Visual Art, French
- NECO (NECO): Mathematics, English Language, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Government, Commerce, Financial Accounting, Civic Education, Literature in English, Geography, Information and Communication Technology, Further Mathematics, Agricultural Science, History, Christian Religious Studies, Islamic Studies, Food and Nutrition, Technical Drawing, Visual Art, French

## Ghana
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-ghana
Exams: WASSCE at the end of senior high school and the BECE at the end of junior high school.
Grading: WASSCE: A1 to F9. BECE: grades 1 to 9 in each subject.
Levels: SHS 1 – SHS 3
Totals: 33 subjects, 559 topics, 2,877 questions.
- WASSCE (WAEC): Core Mathematics, English Language, Social Studies, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Commerce, Financial Accounting, Integrated Science, Elective Mathematics, Agricultural Science, Literature in English, Geography, Information and Communication Technology, Government, History, Christian Religious Studies, Islamic Studies, Food and Nutrition, Technical Drawing, Visual Art, French
- BECE (WAEC): Mathematics, English Language, Integrated Science, Social Studies, Creative Arts and Design, Career Technology, French, Home Economics, Information and Communication Technology, Religious and Moral Education

## Sierra Leone
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-sierra-leone
Exams: WASSCE for senior secondary, the BECE for junior secondary and the NPSE for primary.
Grading: WASSCE: A1 to F9.
Levels: SS1 – SS3
Totals: 42 subjects, 637 topics, 3,267 questions.
- WASSCE (WAEC): Core Mathematics, English Language, Social Studies, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Commerce, Financial Accounting, Integrated Science, Further Mathematics, Agricultural Science, Literature in English, Geography, Information and Communication Technology, Government, History, Christian Religious Studies, Islamic Studies, Food and Nutrition, Technical Drawing, Visual Art, French
- BECE (WAEC): Mathematics, English Language, Integrated Science, Social Studies, Agricultural Science, Business Studies, Basic Technology, French, Civic Education, Home Economics, Computer Studies, Religious and Moral Education
- NPSE (WAEC): Mathematics, English Language, General Studies, Quantitative Aptitude, Verbal Aptitude, Science, Social Studies

## The Gambia
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-gambia
Exams: WASSCE at Grade 12 and the GABECE at the end of basic education.
Grading: WASSCE: A1 to F9.
Levels: Grade 10 – 12
Totals: 35 subjects, 605 topics, 3,107 questions.
- WASSCE (WAEC): Core Mathematics, English Language, Social Studies, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Commerce, Financial Accounting, Further Mathematics, Agricultural Science, Literature in English, Geography, Information and Communication Technology, Government, History, Christian Religious Studies, Islamic Studies, Food and Nutrition, Technical Drawing, Visual Art, French
- GABECE (WAEC): Mathematics, English Language, Social and Environmental Studies, Science, Agricultural Science, Business Studies, Creative Arts, Basic Technology, French, Civic Education, Home Economics, Information and Communication Technology, Religious and Moral Education

## Kenya
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-kenya
Exams: KCSE, set and marked by KNEC at the end of Form 4.
Grading: KCSE: mean grade A to E, from 12 points down to 1.
Levels: Form 3 – Form 4
Totals: 15 subjects, 292 topics, 1,523 questions.
- KCSE (KNEC): Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Geography, History and Government, Business Studies, English Language, Christian Religious Education, Islamic Religious Education, Agriculture, Computer Studies, Literature in English, Kiswahili, Home Science

## Zambia
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-zambia
Exams: ECZ Grade 12 school certificate examinations.
Grading: ECZ: grades 1 (distinction) to 9.
Levels: Grade 10 – 12
Totals: 15 subjects, 317 topics, 1,647 questions.
- ECZ Grade 12 (ECZ): Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Civic Education, Geography, English Language, Religious Education, Agricultural Science, Computer Studies, Literature in English, History, Commerce, Principles of Accounts, Additional Mathematics

## United Kingdom
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-united-kingdom
Exams: GCSE at 16 and A-Level at 18, set by AQA, Edexcel, OCR and WJEC.
Grading: GCSE: 9 to 1. A-Level: A* to E.
Levels: Year 10 – Year 13
Totals: 25 subjects, 537 topics, 2,708 questions.
- GCSE (AQA, Edexcel, OCR, WJEC): Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, English Language, Geography, English Literature, History, Computer Science, Business, Religious Studies, Combined Science
- A-Level (AQA, Edexcel, OCR): Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Further Mathematics, Economics, Psychology, Computer Science, Business, History, Geography, English Literature, Sociology

## Canada
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-canada
Exams: The Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD), from the Ontario Ministry of Education.
Grading: Percentage marks, with Ontario's achievement levels 1 to 4.
Levels: Grade 11 – 12
Totals: 21 subjects, 369 topics, 1,869 questions.
- OSSD (Ontario Ministry of Education): Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, English, Canadian History, Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, Data Management, Computer Science, Geography, Economics, Law, Psychology, Business
- Provincial diploma exams (Alberta Education): Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Social Studies, English Language Arts

## España
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-spain
Exams: The EBAU / PAU university-entrance exam after 2º Bachillerato.
Grading: EBAU: 0 to 14, from the general phase (0 to 10) plus the voluntary phase.
Levels: 1º – 2º Bachillerato
Totals: 20 subjects, 295 topics, 1,475 questions.
- EBAU / Selectividad (Ministerio de Educación y comunidades autónomas): Matemáticas II, Física, Química, Biología, Historia de España, Lengua Castellana y Literatura II, Inglés, Historia de la Filosofía, Matemáticas Aplicadas a las Ciencias Sociales II, Economía de la Empresa, Geografía, Dibujo Técnico II, Latín II, Geología y Ciencias Ambientales, Historia del Arte, Francés, Llengua catalana i literatura II, Valencià: llengua i literatura II, Lingua galega e literatura II, Euskara eta literatura II

## Ireland
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-ireland
Exams: The Leaving Certificate, run by the State Examinations Commission.
Grading: H1 to H8 (Higher) and O1 to O8 (Ordinary), turned into CAO points.
Levels: 5th – 6th Year
Totals: 18 subjects, 328 topics, 1,664 questions.
- Leaving Certificate (State Examinations Commission (SEC)): Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, English, Geography, Irish, History, Economics, Accounting, Business, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Agricultural Science, Politics and Society, Home Economics, French, Art

## South Africa
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-south-africa
Exams: The National Senior Certificate (NSC, "matric"), set by the Department of Basic Education and quality-assured by Umalusi.
Grading: Level 1 to 7: 7 is 80 to 100%, 6 is 70 to 79%, 5 is 60 to 69%, 4 is 50 to 59%, 3 is 40 to 49%, 2 is 30 to 39% and 1 is 0 to 29%.
Levels: Grade 10 – 12
Totals: 23 subjects, 428 topics, 2,140 questions.
- NSC (DBE and Umalusi): Mathematics, Mathematical Literacy, Physical Sciences, Life Sciences, Accounting, Business Studies, Economics, Geography, History, English Home Language, English First Additional Language, Agricultural Sciences, Information Technology, Computer Applications Technology, Tourism, Consumer Studies, Life Orientation, Engineering Graphics and Design, Religion Studies, Afrikaans First Additional Language, Civil Technology, Electrical Technology, Mechanical Technology

## Uganda
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-uganda
Exams: The Uganda Certificate of Education (UCE, S4) and the Uganda Advanced Certificate of Education (UACE, S6), set by UNEB.
Grading: UCE: grades 1 (best) to 9 and a division. UACE: principal passes A to F and subsidiary O or F.
Levels: S1 – S6
Totals: 28 subjects, 595 topics, 2,975 questions.
- UCE (UNEB): Mathematics, English Language, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Geography, History and Political Education, Commerce, Christian Religious Education, Islamic Religious Education, Agriculture, Computer Studies, Literature in English, Kiswahili, Entrepreneurship Education
- UACE (UNEB): Mathematics, Physics, Biology, Literature in English, General Paper, Subsidiary ICT, Subsidiary Mathematics, Chemistry, Economics, Geography, History, Commerce, Entrepreneurship

## Tanzania
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-tanzania
Exams: The Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (CSEE, Form 4) and the Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (ACSEE, Form 6), set by NECTA.
Grading: CSEE: divisions I to IV and 0 (grades A to F). ACSEE: grades A to F and S, with points for university.
Levels: Form 1 – 6
Totals: 28 subjects, 604 topics, 3,020 questions.
- CSEE (NECTA): Basic Mathematics, English Language, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Geography, History, Commerce, Bible Knowledge, Islamic Knowledge, Agriculture, Information and Computer Studies, Literature in English, Kiswahili
- ACSEE (NECTA): Advanced Mathematics, Physics, Biology, General Studies, Information and Computer Studies, English Language, Basic Applied Mathematics, Chemistry, Economics, Geography, History, Accountancy, Commerce, Kiswahili

## Liberia
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-liberia
Exams: WASSCE at the end of senior high school (Grade 12), administered in Liberia by WAEC.
Grading: WASSCE grades and pass rules are set by WAEC; check the current rules for Liberia.
Levels: Grade 10 – 12
Totals: 9 subjects, 230 topics, 1,222 questions.
- WASSCE (WAEC): English Language, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Economics, Geography, History, Literature in English

## Malta
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-malta
Exams: The Secondary Education Certificate (SEC) at the end of Year 11, and the Matriculation Certificate after two years of sixth form, both set by MATSEC at the University of Malta.
Grading: SEC: Paper II is sat at Levels 1–2 or 2–3, and grade 1 is the highest. Matriculation: grades A to E; AM gives 30 to 6 points and IM 10 to 2 points.
Levels: Year 9 – Sixth Form
Totals: 28 subjects, 596 topics, 3,200 questions.
- SEC (MATSEC (University of Malta)): Mathematics, English Language, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computing, Business Studies, Economics, Accounting, Geography, History, Maltese
- Matriculation (MATSEC (University of Malta)): Pure Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computing, English, Maltese, Accounting, Economics, Geography, History, Psychology, Philosophy, Sociology, Systems of Knowledge

## Zimbabwe
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-zimbabwe
Exams: O Level at the end of Form 4 and A Level at the end of Upper 6, both set by ZIMSEC, the Zimbabwe School Examinations Council.
Grading: O Level: grades A to E, and C or better is a pass. A Level: grades A to E, worth 5 points (A) down to 1 point (E).
Levels: Form 1 – Upper 6
Totals: 10 subjects, 244 topics, 1,220 questions.
- O Level (ZIMSEC): Mathematics, English Language, Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Computer Science
- A Level (ZIMSEC): Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology

## Botswana
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-botswana
Exams: The Botswana General Certificate of Secondary Education (BGCSE) at the end of Form 5, set by the Botswana Examinations Council (BEC). The Junior Certificate (JCE) comes at the end of Form 3.
Grading: BGCSE grades run from A* (highest) to G; U means ungraded.
Levels: Form 1 – Form 5
Totals: 6 subjects, 134 topics, 670 questions.
- BGCSE (BEC): Computer Studies, Mathematics, English Language, Biology, Chemistry, Physics

## France
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-france
Exams: The baccalauréat, general and technological tracks. Première students sit the épreuves anticipées (French, and from 2026 a written mathematics paper for every student); Terminale students sit philosophy, two specialty subjects and the Grand oral. Continuous assessment counts for 40% of the final mark.
Grading: Marks are out of 20. The bac is passed with an average of 10/20; mentions start at 12 (assez bien), 14 (bien) and 16 (très bien).
Levels: Seconde – Terminale
Totals: 51 subjects, 764 topics, 3,820 questions.
- Épreuves anticipées (Ministère de l'Éducation nationale): Mathématiques (spécialité), Français, Mathématiques (sans spécialité), Français (voie technologique), Mathématiques (voie technologique)
- Baccalauréat (Ministère de l'Éducation nationale): Philosophie, Mathématiques, Physique-chimie, SVT, SES, HGGSP, HLP, NSI, Grand oral, Sciences de l'ingénieur, Anglais (LLCER), Enseignement scientifique, Histoire-géographie, Espagnol (LLCER), Allemand (LLCER), Anglais, monde contemporain (AMC), Latin (LLCA), Grec ancien (LLCA), Arts plastiques, Cinéma-audiovisuel, Musique, Théâtre, Histoire des arts, Danse, Biologie-écologie, Éducation physique, pratiques et culture sportives (EPPCS), Enseignement moral et civique (EMC), Anglais (langue vivante), Espagnol (langue vivante), Allemand (langue vivante)
- Bac technologique (Ministère de l'Éducation nationale): Droit et économie (STMG), Management, sciences de gestion et numérique (STMG), Physique-chimie et mathématiques (STI2D, STL), Ingénierie, innovation et développement durable (STI2D), Sciences et techniques sanitaires et sociales (ST2S), Chimie, biologie et physiopathologie humaines (ST2S), Biochimie, biologie et biotechnologie (STL), Sciences physiques et chimiques en laboratoire (STL), Philosophie (voie technologique), Analyse et méthodes en design (STD2A), Conception et création en design et métiers d'art (STD2A), Économie et gestion hôtelière (STHR), Sciences et technologies culinaires et des services – ESAE (STHR), Culture et sciences chorégraphiques, musicales ou théâtrales (S2TMD), Gestion des ressources et de l'alimentation (STAV), Territoires et technologie (STAV)

## Italia
URL: https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-italy
Exams: The Esame di Maturità (renamed from Esame di Stato by the 2025 reform) at the end of the fifth year of upper secondary school: a common Italian paper (prima prova), a second written paper in the subject that defines each school track (seconda prova), and an oral (colloquio) on four subjects set by the Ministry. The credito scolastico from the last three years counts for up to 40 of the 100 points.
Grading: The Maturità is marked out of 100, and 60 is a pass. Students who reach 90 can receive up to 3 bonus points, and 100 can come with lode.
Levels: Terzo – Quinto anno
Totals: 19 subjects, 297 topics, 1,485 questions.
- Esame di Maturità (Ministero dell'Istruzione e del Merito): Italiano (prima prova), Matematica (liceo scientifico), Latino (liceo classico), Greco (liceo classico), Scienze umane, Economia aziendale (AFM), Storia, Filosofia, Lingua e cultura inglese, Fisica (liceo scientifico), Sistemi e reti (Informatica), Discipline turistiche e aziendali (Turismo), Progettazione, costruzioni e impianti (CAT), Diritto ed economia politica, Scienze naturali, Storia dell'arte, Lingua e cultura francese, Lingua e cultura spagnola, Lingua e cultura tedesca

## FAQ
**Which exams does Ace Education cover today?** More than twenty exams across nineteen countries, including: WASSCE, NECO and UTME in Nigeria; WASSCE and BECE in Ghana; WASSCE, BECE and NPSE in Sierra Leone; WASSCE and GABECE in The Gambia; WASSCE in Liberia; KCSE in Kenya; ECZ Grade 12 in Zambia; GCSE and A-Level in the UK; the OSSD and Alberta diploma exams in Canada; the PAU (EBAU) in Spain with regional content; the Leaving Certificate in Ireland; the NSC in South Africa; UCE and UACE in Uganda; CSEE and ACSEE in Tanzania; O Level and A Level in Zimbabwe; BGCSE in Botswana; the baccalauréat in France; the Esame di Maturità in Italy; and the SEC in Malta. The Countries page shows exactly which subjects each one has.
**Are the questions copied from past papers?** No. Topic lists follow each exam body's published syllabus, and the notes and questions are written for the app. We do not reproduce past papers or textbooks.
**Has a teacher checked the content?** Every note and question is checked by code (answers recomputed, duplicates and answer positions tested) and read through for local accuracy. A subject teacher's sign-off is the next stage, and until it happens the item carries a "needs review" label. The Countries page shows the review status for each country.
**How do you make sure the content is local?** Each country has its own file with its own exams, subjects, currency, tax rate and examples. A Kenyan student sees shillings and 16% VAT, a student in Ireland sees euro and 23% VAT, and a student in Canada sees 13% HST and 120 V mains.
**Is it free for students?** Anyone can create a student account and start practising. Schools and centres agree a plan with us for class tools and extra seats. See the Quote page.
**Does it work on a phone with little data?** The app is a web page that works in a phone browser with no download. Pages are text-first and light. A dedicated data-saver mode and offline use are on the roadmap.
**Is my data safe?** We collect only what the service needs, we do not sell data, and students or schools can ask for deletion at any time. The Privacy page lists the data-protection law that applies in each country.
**Can a school use it for a whole class?** Yes. A school gets a school code and a staff dashboard: teachers add classes, students join with the code, and teachers see class results and set tasks. Ask us for a quote and we will onboard your school.
**Which country is next?** All the countries listed are open now. We add a country by adding a syllabus file, so new ones can follow quickly. Tell us which you need on the Contact page.
